title: Dissolute
summary: DISSOLUTE, adjective [Latin] 1. Loose in behavior and morals; given to vice and dissipation; wanton; lewd; luxurious; debauched; not under the restraints of law; as a dissolute man; dissolute company.

inlines.v: DISSOLUTE, adjective [Latin] 1. Loose in behavior and morals; given to vice and dissipation; wanton; lewd; luxurious; debauched; not under the restraints of law; as a dissolute man; dissolute company. 2. Vicious; wanton; devoted to pleasure and dissipation; as a dissolute life.
